notes.notes:
Drop by the [url=https://discord.gg/AxxpQ8h]Super Hockey Ball Discord server[/url] and chat with us! Ask questions, make fun of the devs, learn to control the ball, get technical assistance, or anything else. 

We'll be there from 1pm to 4pm EDT, then again from 7pm to 10pm EDT.
Join us anytime! We're usually hanging around.

notes.title: Super Hockey Ball - VR Street Hockey!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=KHcw8dRFojc;full][/previewyoutube]

Become a [i]Super Hockey Baller[/i]! Take your ball through a variety of skills challenges, each more difficult than the last. Learn to shoot with accuracy and control the ball like a [b]pro[/b]. A pro what? A pro something. Don't worry about it. Just get out there, destroy those targets, and collect some coins. Coins are important. You can tell they're important because they're shiny and they give you points.

So, go! Go be whatever a [i]Super Hockey Baller[/i] is. We don't know. This is a game about hitting a ball with a stick. Invent your own narrative!

Need some help with the game? Or just looking for more info? 
[url=https://discord.gg/AxxpQ8h]Join us on Discord[/url]!
